headline: Fragmented Collateral vs. Unified Margin
subhead: Isolated pools restrict capital efficiency. SmartAccounts assess health across your entire portfolio.

blocks.text: Isolated Pools: Collateral is fragmented across separate deposits for every borrow, trapping capital in silos.
Vanna SmartAccount: One collateral balance backs multiple positions, evaluated across the entire account.

focal.reason: Directs focus to the primary value proposition of a single collateral balance backing multiple positions simultaneously.
